name: The Drowned Gate
intro: A gate of iron and bone stands in the flood, and the drowned hold it shut from the far side.

aspects.name: Grasping Chains
aspects.line: Rusted chains rise from the flood and you haul your ankles free of them.

aspects.name: Choir of the Sunk
aspects.line: The drowned sing up through the water and you do not turn to listen.

aspects.name: Shifting Locks
aspects.line: The bolts slide about in the gate face and you find the one that holds.

aspects.name: The Weeping Bars
aspects.line: Water sheets down the bars and you climb them as the rust comes away.

name: The Bell Below
intro: A bell the size of a chapel hangs in the flood, and something on the far side still rings it.

aspects.name: The Swinging Tongue
aspects.line: The iron tongue swings out of the dark and you duck beneath its arc.

aspects.name: The Wet Knots
aspects.line: Swollen knots bind the bell rope and you pick the pull that will still it.

aspects.name: The Peal
aspects.line: The peal comes up through your teeth and you keep your grip on the rope.

aspects.name: The Yoke Beam
aspects.line: The beam that hangs the bell groans and you set your shoulder under it.

name: The Black Tide
intro: The water in the low hall is rising, and it comes up the stair one wet step at a time.

aspects.name: The Undertow
aspects.line: The pull takes your knees and you dig your heels into the silt.

aspects.name: The Wrack
aspects.line: Spars and rope ride the surface and you cross them before they turn.

aspects.name: The Rising Cold
aspects.line: The flood climbs one rib at a time and you hold the lantern above it.

aspects.name: The Tide Marks
aspects.line: Old salt lines score the wall and you trace where the water will stop.

name: The Rust Engine
intro: A pump of rust and bone still works under the hall, and every turn of it lifts the water a hand.

aspects.name: The Windlass
aspects.line: The drum runs back against you and you hold the crank with your whole weight.

aspects.name: The Bucket Ladder
aspects.line: Iron buckets climb and spill in turn and you cross between them as they pass.

aspects.name: The Choked Gear
aspects.line: Silt packs the teeth of the gear and you name the tooth that will give.

aspects.name: The Sump
aspects.line: The black water below runs loud and you work above it without looking down.

name: The Silt Well
intro: A well of silt opens under the flagstones, and every lantern lowered into it is still down there.

aspects.name: The Open Floor
aspects.line: Flagstones tilt into the dark and you step only where they hold.

aspects.name: The Bone Reckoning
aspects.line: Old bones lie in a ring on the silt and you learn what set them there.

aspects.name: The Long Silence
aspects.line: Nothing moves in the pit and you walk across it anyway.

aspects.name: The Settling Roof
aspects.line: The roof stone comes down on the silt and you hold the gap open with your back.

name: The Iron Sluice
intro: A wall of rusted iron holds back a whole drowned sea, and the wheel that opens it is turning.

aspects.name: The Sluice Wheel
aspects.line: The wheel spins the wrong way and you drag it back a spoke at a time.

aspects.name: The Flood Gauge
aspects.line: Rust marks climb the iron toward the last one and you count what is left.

aspects.name: The Failing Seam
aspects.line: Water threads through the rivets at your feet and you stay at the wall.

aspects.name: The Slick Walk
aspects.line: The walk along the top is wet iron and you cross it with the sea at your side.
